summary: Iteration 7 — verified The Beginning 7-step gated experience (backend + frontend) and social/Instagram CTA wiring across Library, Bookstore, Footer, Reach Out. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed including unauth 401s, init/start/reflect validation, full 7-step flow, reset, and books/brand regression. Frontend: landing tb-* blocks render, signed-out CTA correctly redirects to /portal?next=/the-beginning/step, authenticated step flow completes 7 reflections with ~8s soft pause and renders tb-step-done, all social and Instagram CTAs verified, footer Explore links to /the-beginning, mobile nav works, portal-sign-in redirects to auth.emergentagent.com with next param preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1867 lines — consider splitting EXPERIENCE_STEPS, the experience routes, books/content/auth/reach-out into separate routers under backend/routers/ for maintainability.

POST /api/experience/the-beginning/reflect auto-starts if not started — works, but the start endpoint becomes redundant for the happy path. Consider whether you want a strict gate (must POST /start first) or keep auto-start for quick re-engagement (current behavior is fine, just document it).

ExperienceProgress.last_step_at uses ISO string in Mongo, parsed with datetime.fromisoformat — fine on Py3.11 but be careful if any legacy 'Z' suffix appears (handle once with .replace('Z','+00:00')).

STEP_PAUSE_SECONDS=8 lives in server.py only; if a UI fallback ever ships without backend reachability, the pause is lost. Consider exposing as part of /me payload (it already returns pause_remaining, but not the configured pause_seconds itself — currently sent only on /reflect).

Frontend lib/api.js stores session in localStorage (aurin_session_token) AND backend uses cookie. Make sure logout clears both — current /auth/logout deletes the cookie but does not call setToken(null) on the client; verify UserPortal/logout flow does.
test_credentials: No real auth used. Synthetic user_session injected directly into Mongo (db.users + db.user_sessions) and Bearer token sent. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty — fine for this iteration since OAuth was not exercised.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic test users (prefix TEST_USER_/TEST_FE_) and matching user_sessions were created in Mongo for both backend (pytest fixtures auto-cleanup) and frontend (manually cleaned up post-test). experience_progress for those users was wiped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints under /api/experience/the-beginning/* (me, start, reflect, reset) all 401 unauthenticated and work via Bearer header for synthetic sessions. STEP_PAUSE_SECONDS=8, MIN_REFLECTION_CHARS=6, TOTAL_STEPS=7. /me payload shape: {started, current_step, total_steps, completed_steps, is_done, pause_remaining, step:{n,intro,guidance,prompt}|null, reflections:[{n,text,presence,written_at}]}. /reflect returns {status,next_step,is_done,pause_seconds}. After 7 reflections is_done=true and pause_seconds=0. Frontend: data-testid='page-the-beginning' (landing) with blocks tb-recognition, tb-shift, tb-what, tb-balance, tb-notice, tb-honest, tb-coming-soon, tb-cta-wrap, tb-back-library, tb-cta-begin. /the-beginning/step renders page-the-beginning-step with tb-step-form (containing tb-step-content + tb-step-reflection textarea + tb-step-presence with tb-step-presence-1..5 + tb-step-submit), tb-step-error appears for empty/<6 char text. Soft pause panel tb-step-pause appears between steps then form reappears (~8s). After 7 reflections tb-step-done shows with 7 tb-reflection-{n} items inside tb-step-reflections. tb-step-reset returns to step 1. Library: library-feature-row contains library-the-beginning-card (href=/the-beginning) and library-ig-cta-link (https://www.instagram.com/pruesoul.life/, _blank). Bookstore has bookstore-ig-cta-link above grid. Footer has footer-social with footer-social-instagram (https://www.instagram.com/pruesoul.life/) and footer-social-facebook (https://www.facebook.com/groups/4059152880969336/) and Explore column has /the-beginning link. Reach Out has reach-out-social with same two socials. Mobile nav (after clicking mobile-menu-toggle) shows nav-the-beginning-mobile. Portal sign-in actually navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=...&next=%252Fthe-beginning%252Fstep — the next param IS preserved. Smoke routes all returned 200; 9/10 rendered page-header testid (homepage / does not use the page-header component which is by-design — homepage has its own hero). Books still 6, brand entry still served (regression confirmed).
rca of the issue: n/a — no defects found this iteration. Note for future agents: the homepage / does not have data-testid='page-header'; do not assert it on the homepage. Use a more general 'site-header' or 'desktop-nav' check for /.
